content: Ṣṣumɛet n Babil
Tuɣa marra tammurt s yiřes d ijjen u s řhard d ijjen.
Imsar řami fesyen iqiḍan nsen uca ffɣen-dd zi ccarq, ufin ijj n řewḍa di temmurt n Cinɛar, uca qqimen zeddɣen dinni.
Nitni nnan, kuř ijj i wenneɣni: “Araḥem-dd, ad negg iẓra zi třaxt, ad ten nesseḥma!” Ammu i d asen tedweř třaxt d aẓru u acarmuḍ idweř ɣarsen d tarrist.
Xas uca nnan: “Zid, ad nebna ict n tendint d ict n ṣṣumɛet, taqiccat nnes ad dd-taweḍ ɣar ujenna, u jjem aneɣ ad negg ijj n yisem i neccin, ḥima war nᵉttemsebḍi ca x wudem n marra tammurt.”
Xenni ihwa-dd SIDI, ḥima ad iẓar tandint d ṣṣumɛet nni bnan tarwa n bnadem.
Inna SIDI: “Xzar, aqa aten d řgens d ijjen u marra ina ɣarsen ijj n yiřes. Wa d beddu n min ɣa ggen. Řexxu war din min ten i ɣa issbedden x webrid nsen nni nwan ad ggen.
Araḥem-dd, ad nehwa uca ad nessxarweḍ iřes nsen, ḥima kuř ijjen war ifehhem ɛad iřes n wenni t yudsen.”
Ammu i ten izzuzar SIDI ssenni x wudem n marra tammurt uca ssbedden řebni n tendint.
X uya i d as řaɣan i tendint nni s yisem n ‘Babil’, minzi din issxarweḍ SIDI iřes n marra tammurt u ssenni i ten izzuzar SIDI x wudem n marra tammurt. Ina d imezruyen n yinni dd-ittwaxeřqen zi Cam.
Tarwa n Cam
Umi tuɣa ɣar Cam mya n iseggʷusa, ijja-dd Arfakcad, tnayen n iseggʷusa awarni i sseḥřet.
Awarni řami dd-ijja Arfakcad, iddar Cam ɛad xemsa-mya n iseggʷusa, uca ijja-dd iḥenjiren d tḥenjirin.
Iddar Arfakcad xemsa u-třatin n iseggʷusa, xenni ijja-dd Calaḥ.
Awarni řami dd-ijja Arfakcad Calaḥ, iddar ɛad arebɛa-mya u-třata n iseggʷusa, uca ijja-dd iḥenjiren d tḥenjirin.
Iddar Calaḥ třatin n iseggʷusa, xenni ijja-dd Ɛabir.
Awarni řami dd-ijja Calaḥ Ɛabir, iddar ɛad arebɛa-mya u-třata n iseggʷusa, uca ijja-dd iḥenjiren d tḥenjirin.
Iddar Ɛabir arebɛa u-třatin n iseggʷusa, xenni ijja-dd Falaj.
Awarni řami dd-ijja Falaj, iddar Ɛabir ɛad arebɛa-mya u-třatin n iseggʷusa, uca ijja-dd iḥenjiren d tḥenjirin.
Iddar Falaj třatin n iseggʷusa, xenni ijja-dd Raɛuw.
Awarni řami dd-ijja Raɛuw, iddar Falaj ɛad mitayen u-tesɛa n iseggʷusa, uca ijja-dd iḥenjiren d tḥenjirin.
Iddar Raɛuw tnayen u-třatin n iseggʷusa, xenni ijja-dd Saruj.
Awarni řami dd-ijja Saruj, iddar Raɛuw ɛad mitayen u-sebɛa n iseggʷusa, uca ijja-dd iḥenjiren d tḥenjirin.
Iddar Saruj třatin n iseggʷusa, xenni ijja-dd Naḥur.
Awarni řami dd-ijja Naḥur, iddar Saruj ɛad mitayen n iseggʷusa, uca ijja-dd iḥenjiren d tḥenjirin.
Iddar Naḥur tesɛa u-ɛicrin n iseggʷusa, xenni ijja-dd Taraḥ.
Awarni řami dd-ijja Naḥur Taraḥ, iddar ɛad mya u-tesɛaṭac n iseggʷusa, uca ijja-dd iḥenjiren d tḥenjirin.
Iddar Taraḥ sebɛin n iseggʷusa, xenni ijja-dd Abram, Naḥur d Haran. Ina d imezruyen n yinni dd-ittwaxeřqen zi Taraḥ.
Taraḥ ijja-dd Abram, Naḥur d Haran, u Haran ijja-dd Luṭ.
Immut Haran zzat i babas Taraḥ di temmurt mani dd-ixřeq netta, di Ur n Ikaldaniyyen.
Uca ksin Abram d Naḥur i yixef nsen timɣarin. Isem n temɣart n Abram tuɣa-t d Saray u isem n temɣart n Naḥur d Milka, yeǧis n Haran, babas n Milka d Yiska.
Saray tuɣa-tt war dd-tᵉttiruw, tuɣa war ɣares bu uḥenjir.

Uca iksi Taraḥ Abram, mmis, d Luṭ mmis n Haran, mmis n mmis, d Saray, tasřit nnes, tamɣart n mmis Abram, uca nitni ffɣen jmiɛ zi Ur n Ikaldaniyyen, ḥima ad raḥen ɣar temmurt n Kenɛan. Iwḍen ɣar Ḥaran uca zeddɣen dinni.
Umi tegga Taraḥ mitayen u-xemsa n iseggʷusa, immut Taraḥ di Ḥaran.

footnotes.text: Babil- isem-a wanita ixs ad yini ‘axarweḍ’ niɣ ‘Arebbi issxarwaḍ’.

afessar - deg wedlis Amezwaru 5:32 neqqar aqa Cam ittwaxeřqed-dd awarni řami tuɣa Nuḥ ɣares 500 n iseggʷusa. Deg useggʷas wiss setta mya n tudart n Nuḥ tebda sseḥret (Amz. 7:11). Tuɣa tusa-dd sseḥřet ijj n useggʷas x temmurt. Ak-d ineɣmisen i nufa deg wawařen n aya-ya nessen aqa Nuḥ tuɣa ɣares 502 n iseggʷusa řami dd-ittwaxeřq Cam. Cam- isem-a wanita ixs ad yini ‘isem’.
afessar - aqa Cam idweř ɣares 600 n iseggʷusa. S uyenni tuɣa ɛad iddar řami tuɣa Ibrahim ɣares 50 n iseggʷusa.
Calaḥ- isem wanita ixs ad yini ‘řesnaḥ’ niɣ ‘arraw’.
Ɛabir- isem wanita ixs ad yini ‘tammurt n ujemmaḍ’.
Falaj- isem wanita ixs ad yini ‘abeṭṭu’ niɣ ‘afeǧeq’.
Raɛuw- isem wanita ixs ad yini ‘ameddukkeř’.
Saruj- isem wanita ixs ad yini ‘taseṭṭa’ niɣ ‘řfarɛ’.
Naḥur- isem wanita ixs ad yini ‘aneffeḥ yuǧɣen’.
Taraḥ- isem wanita ixs ad yini ‘amcan n wareyyeḥ’.
Abram- isem-a wanita ixs ad yini ‘tababat iɛuǧen’ niɣ ‘babas n Aram’.

Ikaldaniyyen- Ikaldaniyyen tuɣa zeddɣen di jjwayeh n Ur, ict n tendint di tgeldit n Misuputamiya. Deg wussan-a nessen belli jjwayeh n Misuputamiya aqa-tent d ccamal n Lɛiraq. Ař i řexxu aṭṭas n iwdan di ccamal n Lɛiraq ssawařen s tutlayt n Tkaldanit.
